SELECT FN_MAKE_CODE('COMPANY') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_COMPANY_MASTER ( COMPANY_CODE, COMPANY_NAME, CEO_NAME, CEO_PHONE, COMPANY_EMAIL, INDUSTRY_TYPE, BUSINESS_TYPE, MANAGER_NAME, EMPLOYEE_COUNT, BNO, CHECK_NO, COMPANY_ADDRESS, COMPANY_PHONE, MANAGER_PHONE, MANAGER_EMAIL,
CREATED_BY, CREATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{companyCode}, #{companyName}, #{ceoName}, #{ceoPhone}, #{companyEmail}, #{industryType}, #{businessType}, #{managerName}, #{employeeCount}, #{bno}, #{checkNo}, #{companyAddress}, #{companyPhone}, #{managerPhone}, #{managerEmail},
#{createdBy}, #{createDate}, #{updatedBy}, #{updateDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT COMPANY_CODE, COMPANY_NAME, CEO_NAME, COMPANY_ADDRESS, CEO_PHONE FROM TB_COMPANY_MASTER WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}

SELECT c.COMPANY_CODE, c.COMPANY_NAME, c.CEO_NAME, c.CEO_PHONE, c.COMPANY_EMAIL, c.MANAGER_NAME, c.MANAGER_PHONE, s.SUB_CODE, s.SUBS_STATUS, st.CODE_NAME AS subsStatusName FROM TB_COMPANY_MASTER c JOIN TB_SUBSCRIBE s ON c.COMPANY_CODE = s.COMPANY_CODE JOIN TB_CM_CODE st ON st.CODE = s.SUBS_STATUS
s.SUBS_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
AND c.COMPANY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{companyName} || '%'
AND c.CEO_NAME LIKE '%' || #{ceoName} || '%'
ORDER BY c.COMPANY_CODE

SELECT company_code, company_name, ceo_name, ceo_phone, company_email, company_address, bno, manager_name, manager_phone, business_type, industry_type, employee_count, created_by, create_date, updated_by, update_date FROM TB_COMPANY_MASTER WHERE company_code = #{companyCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COMPANY_MASTER SET company_name = #{companyName}, ceo_name = #{ceoName}, ceo_phone = #{ceoPhone}, bno = #{bno}, manager_name = #{managerName}, manager_phone = #{managerPhone}, company_email = #{companyEmail}, company_address = #{companyAddress}, update_date = SYSDATE WHERE company_code = #{companyCode}
